title: JSON-LD gets its @context, server rendering skips server calls, and dev matches production
why: Google dropped JSON-LD blocks written without @context, an fx calling a server function during server rendering ran fetch() with a relative URL, a fallback could not be matched to its log line, and brain run reloaded on ignored writes and rendered the 404 page without its layouts.
